explicit_limits: This is a plain-Ruby and dependency-free gem-layout profile; it does not imply Rails, Zeitwerk, ActiveSupport, ActiveRecord, Rack, ERB, native extensions, or another framework/build profile.

Only .rb is source-inventory-owned. Gemfile, Gemfile.lock, gems.rb, gems.locked, Rakefile, *.gemspec, *.rake, and *.ru are project or DSL boundaries; the current suffix-only shared inventory cannot assign every extensionless or globbed DSL file a Ruby source role.
Each ruby -c verification must run once per selected file. One successful invocation must never be reported as validating additional files.

Bundler execution is limited to check or bundle exec against an already locked and locally satisfied project with frozen/version-check-disabled settings; install, update, lock mutation, and remote resolution are outside the product path.

Prism 1.2.0 is bundled with the observed Ruby 3.4.1 runtime and can provide syntax, token, comment, and source-location facts. Prism does not resolve runtime constants, dynamic dispatch, require targets, autoload, monkey patches, class/module reopening, eval, define_method, send, const_get, or other metaprogramming.

Steep is an optional project-owned semantic tool. RBS, TypeProf, Sorbet, RuboCop, Standard Ruby, and Solargraph can contribute only when the audited project owns compatible configuration and dependencies; their absence is a limitation, never evidence that a pending skill is unsupported.
